accuracy.q: How many customers are there?
accuracy.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: How many orders were placed in 1997?
accuracy.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_1997_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('1997-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: Which 3 customers placed the most orders, and how many did each place?
accuracy.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY orders_count DESC, c.company_name LIMIT 3

accuracy.q: List the 5 most expensive products and their prices.
accuracy.sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

accuracy.q: How many products are in each category?
accuracy.sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories AS c LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_id LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: How many orders did each shipping company handle?
accuracy.sql: SELECT s.shipper_id, s.company_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_count FROM shippers AS s LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name ORDER BY orders_count DESC LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: What is the last name of the employee who handled the most orders, and how many orders was that?
accuracy.sql: SELECT e.last_name, o.order_count FROM (SELECT employee_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE employee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY employee_id) AS o JOIN employees AS e USING (employee_id) WHERE o.order_count = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE employee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY employee_id) AS t) LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: What was the total revenue after discounts in 1997?
accuracy.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 0) AS total_revenue_after_discounts_1997 FROM orders AS o JOIN order_details AS od ON o.order_id = od.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('1997-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: What was the revenue after discounts for each product category in 1997?
accuracy.sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_details AS od JOIN orders AS o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON od.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN CAST('1997-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('1997-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: Which country has the most customers, and how many?
accuracy.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

accuracy.q: How many products are discontinued?
accuracy.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS discontinued_count FROM products WHERE discontinued <> 0 LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: Which products are out of stock?
accuracy.sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, units_in_stock FROM products WHERE units_in_stock <= 0 ORDER BY product_name LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: What is the average freight cost per order for each shipping company?
accuracy.sql: SELECT s.shipper_id, s.company_name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(o.freight) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_freight FROM shippers AS s LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name ORDER BY s.company_name LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: How many orders were placed in each month of 1997?
accuracy.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS INT) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('1997-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: Which suppliers are based in Germany?
accuracy.sql: SELECT supplier_id, company_name, contact_name, contact_title, address, city, region, postal_code, country, phone, fax FROM suppliers WHERE country ILIKE 'germany' ORDER BY company_name LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: What are the top 5 products by total quantity sold?
accuracy.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(od.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_details AS od JOIN products AS p ON od.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5

accuracy.q: Which customers have never placed an order?
accuracy.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: How many orders were shipped after their required date?
accuracy.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_shipped_after_required FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND required_date IS NOT NULL AND shipped_date > required_date LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: What is the average number of days between order date and shipped date for shipped orders?
accuracy.sql: SELECT AVG(shipped_date - order_date) AS average_days_between_order_and_shipped FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: List the last names of employees who report to Andrew Fuller.
accuracy.sql: SELECT e.last_name FROM employees AS e JOIN employees AS m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Andrew' AND m.last_name = 'Fuller' LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: Which countries have more than 5 customers, and how many customers does each have?
accuracy.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: What is the total value of stock on hand (unit price times units in stock) across all products?
accuracy.sql: SELECT SUM(COALESCE(unit_price, 0) * COALESCE(units_in_stock, 0)) AS total_stock_value FROM products LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: Which product category generated the highest revenue after discounts across all years?
accuracy.sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - COALESCE(od.discount, 0))) AS revenue FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN order_details AS od ON od.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

accuracy.q: How many distinct products has the customer Ernst Handel ordered?
accuracy.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.product_id) AS distinct_products FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_details AS od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE c.company_name = 'Ernst Handel' LIMIT 200

accuracy.q: How many orders contain more than 5 different products?
accuracy.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_more_than_5_distinct_products FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_details GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 5) AS t LIMIT 200
